basis: approval date (CalGEM's determination on the notice of intention, as a California day)
cadence: daily (the layer is current to the day)
name: California
note: Approved notices of intention (permits to drill, rework or plug), by the day CalGEM approved them. The layer starts on November 14, 2024 (the first month is a part month), so the series begins there, not in 2019. New wells are New Drill notices; those for injection, disposal, steam or water flood, storage, observation and water-source wells are their own band. Reworks (recompletions and conversions together) and sidetracks and deepenings have their own bands; plugging, about two thirds of all notices, is 'other filings'. Amendments are not told. Canceled notices are left out. Almost no new-drill permit was approved in 2025 and several hundred in 2026, so the change from the year before reflects what CalGEM approved, not necessarily what was drilled. 'Oil & Gas' is one CalGEM well type (shown as both); cyclic steam wells count as oil.

source.name: WellSTAR Notices map service, Approved Notice of Intention/Permit layer
